message.content:
You are working in the Rust crate "musicrs" (MUSIC DOA estimation). Read CLAUDE.md first and follow it (edition 2024, cargo fmt defaults, small logical commits each building and passing tests).

Setup (do this first, in your working directory):
  git switch -c fix/select-bins-scale 6e41e8b
Base is commit 6e41e8b (tip of feat/test-gaps-3), NOT main. Do not touch any other branch, do not push, do not open PRs, do not merge.

Build hygiene: the machine is small (3 cores). Prefix EVERY cargo command with
  CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-orchid-projects-musicrs/860b07ee-3f92-4815-ab52-690d0ae10c8e/scratchpad/target-agents
(shared with other agents; cargo's lock may make you wait — that is expected, do not delete the lock or the dir).

Before finishing, all of these must pass on your branch:
  cargo fmt --check
  cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo test -- --include-ignored
Add regression tests for behaviour changes (unit tests in src/ or the relevant file in tests/, e.g. tests/errors_test.rs for new errors — every public MusicError the API returns is tested there). Keep doc comments, README and CLAUDE.md accurate for what you change (CLAUDE.md lists tests and the MusicError contract).

Commit messages: imperative subject line like the repo's history (see git log), body explaining why, and end each commit message with the line:
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Keep the diff minimal and focused on your task — other agents are changing other parts of src/music.rs and src/stft.rs on parallel branches, so do not refactor or reformat unrelated code.

Final report (short): branch name, commit hashes + subjects, the exact test/clippy/fmt results, and anything you decided or could not do.

YOUR TASK:
select_bins_by_energy (src/music.rs) is the only data entry point that does not normalise the data with normalised_real(), so its STFT power sums underflow/overflow: a 4-channel 1 kHz tone (16 kHz, nfft 160, threshold 20 dB) scaled by 1e-170 returns Err(SilentData), and scaled by 1e300 selects all 80 bins instead of bin 10. Fix by normalising (after check_real_samples, like ifb_music_spectrum) and add a regression test showing the same bins are selected for scales like 1e-200, 1e-170, 1, 1e150, 1e300. Make sure the silence test (strongest <= 0) still behaves.

<system-reminder>
Other agents active in this session, addressable via SendMessage({to: name, message}): main, fix-ci-hardening, fix-fft-planner-reuse, fix-ifb-memory, fix-stft-huge-nfft, fix-zero-sources.
</system-reminder>
